transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi there. I'm hoping you can help me. I have a question about my most recent mobile bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you. I'll just need to pull up your account first. Could I please get your full name?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course. It's David Lewis.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, David. And can you confirm the 10-digit phone number on the account for me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And for a final security check to protect your account information, could you please provide the 4-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, the PIN. Hold on one second, I have it written down here somewhere... I always forget it. Ah, here we go. It should be 6395.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. Thank you for your patience while we verified that, Mr. Lewis. I have your account details right here in front of me now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. Just call me David, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, David. So, you mentioned a question about your latest bill. Can you tell me what the issue is?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, I got the email notification for my bill, and the total is about fifteen dollars higher than it normally is. I'm looking at it right now, it's eighty dollars. It's always been sixty-five.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. An unexpected increase is definitely something we need to look into. I'm opening your billing statement now. Please allow me just a moment to review the details.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. I just don't remember adding any services or going over any data limits or anything like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, and your plan is the Unlimited 5G plan, so you wouldn't have data overage charges. That's a good thought, though.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'm comparing your latest invoice dated today with your previous one... Yes, I see exactly what you're seeing. The previous twelve invoices were for $65 plus taxes, and this new one is for $80 plus taxes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So what happened? Is it a mistake?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's not a mistake in the system, but I can see why it was a surprise. It appears that a promotional discount you were receiving has expired.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A promotional discount? What was that for?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you first signed up with Cymbal Telecom thirteen months ago, your account was set up with a 'New Customer Welcome' discount. It provided a $15 credit each month for your first 12 months of service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see... I guess I vaguely remember the salesperson mentioning a special price, but I really thought that was the permanent price for the plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, and I do apologize if the temporary nature of that discount wasn't made perfectly clear. The standard, non-promotional rate for the Unlimited 5G Mobile Plan is indeed $80 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow. Okay. So I've just been paying less for a year and now it's jumping up. That's... disappointing. I have to stick to a budget, and a sudden $15 increase is not great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I hear you, David, and I want to help. We value your business and definitely don't want you to be unhappy with our service or pricing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So what can we do? Am I just stuck paying eighty dollars now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not necessarily. Often, once an initial promotion expires, we have other options available for our existing customers. Would you be open to me checking our system for any loyalty discounts or new promotions that could be applied to your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You have other discounts? Yes, please check. Anything to get it closer to what I was paying before.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. This will require me to look through a few different toolkits, so it might take me about two to three minutes. Is it alright if I place you on a brief hold?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, that's fine. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. I'll be as quick as I can.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: David? Thank you so much for holding.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here. Any luck?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I believe so. I've reviewed the available offers, and while we can't re-apply the original 'New Customer' discount, I did find a 'Valued Customer' loyalty credit that you are eligible for.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... and what does that do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This loyalty credit is for $10 per month. If we apply it, it would reduce your monthly bill from the standard $80 down to $70 per month, before taxes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, seventy dollars. That's five dollars more than I was paying, but ten dollars less than the new bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Is that the best you can do? There's no $15 discount available?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand the question. I did specifically look for an equivalent discount, but this $10 credit is the highest value loyalty offer available for your account and plan type at this time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how long does this one last? Is it another one-year thing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's an excellent question to ask. Yes, this is also a 12-month credit. After 12 months, the rate would return to the standard price.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So we'll be doing this all over again next year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a possibility, but my advice is to simply give us a call back as you approach the end of the 12 months. We can review whatever new offers are available then. Our goal is to keep you as a happy customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Does this require a new contract or anything? I don't want to get locked into something.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, not at all. Cymbal Telecom mobile plans are all contract-free. This is simply a monthly credit we apply to your account. You can still make changes or cancel your plan at any time without penalty.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. That's good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, shall I proceed with applying the $10 monthly loyalty credit for the next 12 months?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Let me just think for a second.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, take your time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright. Yes, let's do it. Seventy is manageable. Eighty felt like a bait-and-switch.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand, and I'm glad we could find a resolution. I am processing the change for you right now. It just takes a moment for the system to update and confirm...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And... there we are. Confirmation received. The $10 per month 'Valued Customer' loyalty credit has been successfully applied to your account, David.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. So, when does that start? Will I get a new bill for this month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good question. The credit is effective immediately, as of today. Because your billing cycle has already started, your very next bill will look a little unusual. It will show the full $80 charge, but then it will have a separate line item for a pro-rated credit for the remaining days in this cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Pro-rated... so it won't be the full ten dollar credit on this next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. It will be a portion of it. However, the bill *after* that, and for the next 11 full months, will reflect the simple, new total of $70 plus your local taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I think I follow. So the next bill will be a little weird, but the one after that will be the new normal price.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You've got it perfectly. To make sure you have it in writing, would you like me to send a confirmation email to the address we have on file, david.lewis@telecom-personal.com, outlining this change?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, yes, that would be fantastic. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My pleasure. I'm sending that email now. You should receive it within the next 5-10 minutes. It will also include a reference number for today's call and the changes made.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That gives me peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm also adding a note to your account detailing our conversation and the promotional pricing adjustment, so if you ever need to call back, the next agent will see exactly what we discussed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very thorough. I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try our best to be transparent. Is there anything else at all I can help you with today? Perhaps a question about your data usage, or maybe international calling features?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, no, the billing was my only concern. Everything else with the service has been great, actually. The 5G coverage is solid in my area.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's wonderful to hear! We're always expanding our network, so I'm happy it's serving you well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, it's good. Well, thank you again for your help, Sarah. You really helped clear this up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure, David. I'm glad I could resolve this for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright then, I'll let you go.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just before you do, let me give you that reference ID for your records over the phone as well. It is C-L-D-7-8-9-0-1.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. C-L-D-7-8-9-0-1. Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Is there anything else, absolutely anything, I can check for you while I have you on the line?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Nope, that was the only thing on my mind. You've solved my problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful to hear. Well, thank you again for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer, David.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You're welcome. And thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. Have a great afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
